result.recordMeaning: Reviewed physical parcel records, not issued building/unit registry records.

reference.transformVersion: area-native-v1 / pyproj 3.6.1 / PROJ 9.3.0 / unavailable until proj_trans is called

result.geometryFrame: Stored local geometry equals the normalizer output in the area reference; geographic geometry is separate.
warnings: The source declares `EPSG:2958`; read as `EPSG:2958`, coordinates in the order written (x, y). Original bytes keep that declaration; normalized geographic geometry uses RFC 7946 coordinates.
Local geometry uses metres in the retained area frame and is not RFC GeoJSON. Building-relative heights do not establish shared elevation or legal rights.
result.choices: Harness chooses kind parcel and identifier OBJECTID; integer identifiers are read as their digits.
result.cards: Not attempted: parcels have records, not building/unit property cards.

evidence.storage: Nonce-scoped in-memory S3 HTTP stand-in as in CB1; no production object-store qualification.
